ABOUT US MSC SARL MSC SARL is a construction and services company based in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, providing reliable solutions to mining companies and public-sector organizations. Driven by a strong commitment to meeting client requirements and ensuring customer satisfaction, MSC SARL is built on a foun- dation of dependable service delivery, technical expertise, safety, and operational excellence. We work closely with our clients to deliver high-quality solutions that meet their needs, support their objectives, and create lasting value. Our ambition is to establish and maintain MSC SARL as a world- class construction and services provider, recognized for its professionalism, innovation, reliability, and contribution to the sustainable development of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
